input: Draft a daily evening shutdown routine for work

gold.taskTitle: Draft a daily evening work shutdown routine
gold.taskDescription: Create a structured end-of-workday routine to consistently wrap up work tasks and mentally disconnect each evening.

questions.title: What time does your workday typically end?
questions.description: Understand the target time the shutdown routine should begin or be completed by.

questions.title: Do you work from home, an office, or both?
questions.description: Identify the physical environment to tailor location-specific shutdown steps.

questions.title: How long should the entire routine realistically take?
questions.description: Determine the time budget available for the shutdown routine each evening.

questions.title: What tools do you use to manage your tasks and calendar?
questions.description: Know which apps or systems (e.g., Notion, Outlook, paper planner) to incorporate into the routine.

questions.title: What does a bad shutdown currently look like for you?
questions.description: Identify the specific pain points or habits the routine needs to fix or replace.

questions.title: Do you need a hard mental boundary between work and personal life?
questions.description: Determine whether the routine should include a deliberate psychological wind-down or closing ritual.

questions.title: Should the routine include planning for the next workday?
questions.description: Clarify whether a next-day preview or priority-setting step belongs inside the shutdown routine.
